explainer_reply:
Looking at these examples, I notice a strong recurring theme: the highlighted tokens come from website template/chrome text rather than main content. Many highlighted tokens immediately precede `<|endoftext|>` (e.g., "Leave a Reply", "View all comments", "Scroll to Top", "Continue Reading Below", "All Right Reserved", "newer »", "loading..."), and others are classic web boilerplate: "Powered by WorldNow", "From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia", "Post A Comment", "Write a Review", "Answer this question", "Copied to clipboard", "Ad blocker interference detected", "Varnish cache server", "Get X in Your Inbox", "Search: Advanced Search".

[EXPLANATION]: Website boilerplate and user-interface text—navigation links, footers, copyright notices, comment/review prompts, and similar template elements—typically appearing at the end of web page documents.
